resourceCollection.description: List of resource ids created by community endpoint.

syncTo.description: Array of ARM resource IDs of destination communities to synchronize this endpoint's rules to. The RP creates and manages the destination CEPs automatically within each community. Maximum 100 destinations per source endpoint.

syncFrom.description: ARM resource ID of the source Community Endpoint that manages this endpoint's rules via synchronization. This property is read-only and set by the RP on destination CEPs created by the sync process.

syncStatus.description: The synchronization status of this Community Endpoint. Tracks sync state independently of provisioningState.

syncDestinationStatuses.description: Per-destination synchronization status. Only populated on source CEPs that have syncTo configured.

syncPerformedBy.description: Information about the principal who last configured or modified syncTo. Set by the RP and surfaced for audit transparency.

protocols.description: Protocols. Options specified by Endpoint Protocol Enum.

direction.description: The direction of traffic for this rule. Defaults to Outbound if not specified.

destination.description: Destination address. Can include multiple CIDR/IP Addresses or fqdn tags or fqdns (for community endpoint) separated by commas.

ports.description: Port. Can include multiple ports separated by commas or a range indicated by a hyphen.

destinationId.description: ARM resource ID of the destination Community Endpoint.

status.description: The synchronization status for this destination.

errorMessage.description: Error message if the sync to this destination failed.

lastSyncTime.description: Timestamp of the last successful sync to this destination.

principalId.description: Object ID of the user principal who configured syncTo.

principalType.description: The type of principal (e.g., User, ServicePrincipal).

performedAt.description: Timestamp when the syncTo was configured or last modified.

correlationId.description: ARM correlation ID from the source PUT that set up syncTo.
